explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/619: EGR98 proved h_3(G) ≤ n for connected triangle-free G on n vertices. minNewEdges 3 G is the least number of edges added to reach a triangle-free supergraph with ediam ≤ 3 (diameter 'at most r', the standard meaning of h_r). The statement is minNewEdges 3 G ≤ |V|. Faithful.
